text: PERFORMANCE Updated [event-reduce-js](https://github.com/pubkey/event-reduce) from `6.0.0` to `7.0.1`. Calculating and applying the EventReduce step for live queries is about **2.7x faster** (20k change events on 10 sorted queries: 830 to 916 ms before, 308 to 331 ms after) and the minified+gzipped bundle is 934 bytes smaller
